summary: The maintainer's go (R131) for the T5 batches. Group 1 appended 313 words to ten language files from the triage's accepted candidates, judged against one combined log of the 79 shards (log sha256 6467504ab8ab, rebuilt by combine_logs.py in the pool folder) rather than one shard. Reading each word's other languages found what the tool could not: laut (the standing refusal of PROVENANCE, which the tool ACCEPTED: 934 German articles, 71 Indonesian ones reading it as sea) and seven more words with a content sense elsewhere (falls, moi, borde, medan, gener, sis, dues), left out by hand with the 4 mojibake fragments and 4 foreign words. The tool now refuses sea/tom/fin/laut with no override and prints the other languages a word was read in. 313 words are declared in test_analytics_extract with the curly spellings of the 46 apostrophe forms. Hidden at query time, no re-index. Left: the bulletin trio still waits for the export thread; groups 2 onward.
